To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) distance factor is a good measure to predict the certainty of a classifier, and (i) a high certainty of a classifier can predict the customer churn and non-churn with higher accuracy.
the classifier's accuracy is strongly co related to the data's certainty.
the distance factor has strong correlation with classifier's certainty, and hence can be used to estimate the classifier performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach for CCP in TCI using distance factor as a measure of certainty.
the prediction of churn and non churn behavior of customers in TCI industry and to estimate the classifier accuracy based on certainty of the prediction.
the development and evaluation of a novel CCP approach based on certainty of the data using distance factor for predicting the customer churn behavior in telecommunication industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the distance factor has a direct correlation with the certainty of a classifier, which in turn has a direct correlation to the accuracy level of a classifier.
a classifier can achieve higher accuracy in the zone of high certainty than in the zone with lower certainty.
the distance factor is an efficient mechanism to estimate certainty of a classifier's prediction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method is able to estimate the classifier certainty for different zones and hence the accuracy for different zones can also be estimated.
, our proposed method can be used as a pre-classifier to estimate the classifier accuracy for the data with high and low certainty before the actual classification.

, the proposed approach can be used to estimate the accuracy of the classifier before the actual prediction of the customers' churn and non churn behavior, and can help in making a decision to take corrective action to retain customers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed CCP approach can be utilized as a pre-processing step for a classifier in order to estimate its accuracy even before the classification, and hence can be used as a tool to select the appropriate classifier for the given dataset.
the classifier's certainty can be used to estimate its accuracy for different zones of data.
the distance factor can be used as a measure to predict customer churn and non-churn behavior.
